name: dbeaver-formatter-bridge
description: Format SQL through the formatter in your running DBeaver instance.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Formatting starts a local CLI and accesses a local DBeaver workspace.

dbeaverFormatter.workspace.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the running **DBeaver workspace**, not the VS Code project directory. Requires the Formatter Bridge plugin.

enumDescriptions: Use the selected, connected SQL tab in DBeaver.
Use the exact connection ID below; the connection must already be connected.
Use the standard SQL dialect and DBeaver global settings.
dbeaverFormatter.connectionMode.description: Where DBeaver obtains its SQL dialect and formatting preferences.

dbeaverFormatter.connectionId.description: Exact DBeaver connection ID. Required only in connection mode.

dbeaverFormatter.timeoutMs.description: DBeaver request timeout in milliseconds. The CLI process has an additional two-second shutdown allowance.
